notes.tag_counting_rule: Counts are product-occurrence counts; repeated identical tags on the same product are counted once. Case-only duplicates were merged in tags, with variants recorded in tag_case_aliases.

notes.results: Fetched 793 products, 1047 exact unique product tags, 1040 case-fold de-duplicated tags, and 46 collections. No margin-tier dimension was found.
notes.residual_risks: This identifies dimensions by existing tag/collection/metafield naming only; it does not prove how Shopify automated collection rules or app feeds use those labels.
notes.next_best_action: Normalize taxonomy by choosing one canonical source for product type, marketing flags, and margin tier before adding new tags.
